title: Kit hits as clips named by pad, each from its own sample
description:
## Intent

Kits and step patterns: one clip per hit, named by pad.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/clips.rs`: use `Event.piece` → `TrackInfo.pieces[piece]` for the clip's sample (`PieceInfo.source`), region and name (`PieceInfo.name` for drum-kit pads, `<kit>.<n>` for slices).
- A track whose pads come from several samples: each clip refers to its own sample; collection covers them all.
- Velocity, swing and humanize need no mapping of their own: they are in the compiled events (`start_beat`, `gain_db`); assert that in specs.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Kits and step patterns in the set" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): kit hits as named clips in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
